# React Native Google Sign In

> Google sign in for Expo and React Native apps

This file contains links to documentation sections following the llmstxt.org standard.

## Table of Contents

- [GoogleLogoButton](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/buttons/google-logo-button): A Google Sign-In button that follows Google's official branding guidelines. Intended for native apps. It renders null when used on the web.
- [WebGoogleSigninButton](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/buttons/web): This is the sign-in button that you can use in web apps. It renders `null` when used in native apps.
